common: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: editorial cover for Circlebook, a Japanese hobby community website. One coherent natural editorial photograph, horizontal 1536x1024 PNG, soft daylight, authentic materials, inviting and uncluttered. Genre equipment grouped centrally, enough breathing room for thumbnail cropping. No people, no text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no readable labels. Generic unbranded items, not a replica of a commercial product image. No collage or contact sheet.

scenes.soccer-first: Outdoor soccer field at a Japanese public sports ground. On a bench, soccer training shoes with small rubber studs, long socks, shin guards, a plain dark training shirt, soccer ball, water bottle and small sports bag. Green pitch and goal softly blurred behind.
scenes.softball-first: Japanese recreational softball field in gentle morning light. An adult softball glove and a large plain softball, folded light uniform trousers, training shoes and sports bottle arranged on a wooden bench. Earth infield and wire fence softly blurred in background.
scenes.pickleball-first: Bright community racket-sport court. Two solid pickleball paddles with plain faces and a few perforated plastic pickleballs, indoor court shoes, towel and paddle sleeve together near the court sidelines. Net in soft background, realistic proportions.
scenes.camera-walk: Outdoor table at a quiet Japanese park in morning light. A generic mirrorless camera with strap and compact lens, padded insert bag, small rubber air blower, folded cleaning cloth, memory card case and compact rain cover. Green walkway softly blurred behind, realistic modest camera kit.
scenes.sauna-small-items: Calm dry changing area beside a Japanese public bath, no people and no wet floor. On a wooden bench, a folded cotton towel, plain fabric sauna hat, small folded seat mat, mesh wash bag, wet-item pouch and water bottle. Warm wood and soft natural light, everyday and welcoming.
scenes.training-first: Clean community gym bench, dumbbells and exercise equipment softly out of focus behind. Unbranded indoor training shoes, plain shirt and shorts, compact training gloves, towel, water bottle and small blank notebook neatly arranged together. Bright natural light, approachable beginner mood.
scenes.golf-range: Japanese golf driving range with green practice mat and distant net. A modest soft club bag holding a few golf clubs beside a bench, one golf glove, plain cap, towel, closed bottle and golf shoes. No logos or signage, calm daylight, no person swinging.
scenes.pier-fishing: Safe broad flat fishing pier on a calm clear day, no people. A solid foam fishing life vest, a closed compact rod case, reel, small lidded tackle box, rope bucket, pliers and compact cooler arranged well back from the water edge. Sea and railing softly blurred behind. No hooks exposed.
scenes.bowling-small-items: Bowling alley seating area under soft warm light. A pair of plain bowling shoes, removable shoe covers beside them, microfiber bowling towel, compact shoe bag and blank pocket notebook on a bench. A bowling ball and lanes in soft background, no readable scoring screens.
scenes.english-tools: Small welcoming cafe table prepared for an English conversation meetup. An open blank ring notebook, pen, blank word cards on a ring, slim book-band pen case and clear document folder. Two empty chairs, daylight from window, no printed text or letters anywhere.
scenes.reading-tools: Cozy cafe reading table. A closed plain-covered paperback with a slim bookmark, an open blank notebook, pen, small colored film page flags and compact book-band pen case. Warm natural window light, empty chairs softly blurred, no readable writing.
scenes.sewing-first: Bright community craft table ready for a hand-sewn fabric pouch workshop. Cotton fabric pieces, spools of thread, needle packet securely closed, small thread scissors and larger fabric shears closed on table, sewing clips, tailor marking pencil, tape measure with no legible markings. Organized realistic sewing kit, no people.
scenes.drawing-first: Community art meetup desk in soft daylight. Open sketchbook with blank paper, graphite pencils, a small set of colored pencils in a tin, kneaded eraser, covered pencil sharpener, fine liner pen and simple pencil case. No drawings or text, gentle color and authentic paper texture.
scenes.band-studio: Rehearsal studio corner, guitar amp and drum kit softly blurred. A folded music stand holding blank sheets, clip tuner, compact tuner-metronome with screen off, coiled instrument cable, small earplug case and accessory pouch on a bench. No people, brands or readable labels.
scenes.darts-first: Table beside a soft-tip electronic darts area with board blurred in background and no readable numbers. A set of three blunt plastic-tip darts, spare plastic tips, separate shafts and flights, compact protective dart case neatly arranged. Realistic sports accessories, warm natural-looking lighting.
scenes.tennis-organizer: Community outdoor hard tennis court prepared before a practice session. A tennis ball basket, several yellow tennis balls, simple ball pickup tube, blank clipboard, small timer with screen off and replacement grip tape on a bench. Court net softly blurred, daylight, no logos.
scenes.running-organizer: Community park meetup point before a group run. On a bench, a blank clipboard, numbered-tag style tags with no text or numbers, bright plain mesh organizer vest, compact blank-screen timer and zipped supply pouch. Path and trees softly blurred, no people.
scenes.cooking-organizer: Bright shared teaching kitchen table. Serving tongs, ladle, blank-screen kitchen scale, shallow stainless preparation trays, plain white masking tape roll, unlabeled dishwashing liquid bottle and clear food-storage bags. Clean realistic utensils, modest practical cooking meetup, no food handling action.
scenes.boardgame-organizer: Community board-game table set for a small meetup. Generic unprinted playing cards in clear sleeves, plain green play mat, felt dice tray with unmarked wooden cubes, small token containers, wooden card holder, blank notebook and compact blank-screen timer. No brand games, no text, cozy daylight.
scenes.study-organizer: Small community study meeting room before participants arrive. On a light table, blank clip-on name badges, stacks of pastel sticky notes, black felt-tip pens, small timer with screen off, and blank clipboard. Empty chairs and simple whiteboard softly blurred behind, soft daylight, inviting realistic scene.
